title: Surchav bar Pappa
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Ketubot 17b](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.17b.2), saying in the name of Ze’iri. Hyman identifies him as the son of Rav Papa Saba, not of the well-known Rav Papa.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Ketubot and [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2778&lang=en) give Surchav bar Pappa speaking in Ze’iri’s name. The teaching explains the bridal hinnuma.
Hyman identifies Surchav’s father as Rav Papa Saba and rules out the more familiar Rav Papa. The linked passage gives only the patronymic.
